download_eli5_ft_model: download the eli5_ft pretrained model from the Dialogue Dodecathlon collection to the given datapath
run_download_dodeca_eli5: run the download function to fetch the eli5_ft model archive into Parlai's model directory
test_download_eli5_ft: test the eli5_ft download function by calling it with a valid datapath argument
review_download_function: review the download function that wraps build.download to fetch the eli5_ft model
summarize_eli5_ft_module: summarize the eli5_ft module which provides a single download function for the ELI5 fine-tuned Dodeca model
